summary: S10 round 1 complete: filmcraft-vpkg implemented, VM gate green, Python interoperability verified; no commits.
body:
Changed `crates/vpkg/`: four modules, public API, README, TDD log, unchanged schema with attribution, tests, fixture generator, and three attributed Python-package fixtures (3.2–3.8 KiB). Updated only the requested workspace dependency, layer entry, attribution rows, and Cargo-generated lockfile entry.

Public API:
```rust
read(bytes: &[u8], limits: &Limits) -> Result<Package, Error>
pack(input: &PackInput) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Error>
manifest::read(bytes: &[u8], limits: &Limits) -> Result<Manifest, Error>
zip::read(bytes: &[u8], limits: &Limits) -> Result<Vec<Entry>, Error>
zip::write(entries: &[Input<'_>], limits: &Limits, epoch: Option<u64>) -> Result<Vec<u8>, Error>
zip::safe_path(path: &str) -> bool
```
`Package` owns verified entries once and exposes the manifest, primary scene path, and warnings. `Manifest.raw` preserves unknown JSON fields; `data` provides typed access.

Design decisions:

- Metadata order is mandatory, following your requirement despite Python’s warning-only behavior. ZIP64, directory records, prefixes, gaps, overlaps, unsafe names, and case collisions are rejected.
- Reference classification, optional caches, included documents, nested asset dependencies, sequence patterns, and pipeline globs follow `refs.py` and `pack.py`. `%Nd` accepts at least N digits; hash runs require exactly N. Matching handles Unicode characters.
- Remote inputs warn during reading, matching `archive.py`; packing refuses them. Drafts are exempt as requested. External/file URI inputs are refused instead of rewritten.
- Included audio contributes to video metadata; captions remain primary-document metadata. The actual scene version replaces Python’s hard-coded `1.1`.
- Fonts, script lint, downloads, pipelines, extraction, and engine wiring remain outside this pure crate. Schema coverage, conservative memory limits, stricter path policies, and all compatibility decisions are documented in [README.md](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/vpkg/crates/vpkg/README.md).

Adapted MIT sources from sr-core `babeccf0`: `sr_core/vpkg/archive.py`, `manifest.py`, `pack.py`, `readme.py`, and `refs.py`. Notices and attribution rows are included. ZIP binary parsing/writing is original.

TDD red → green:

- Foundation: 12 failures → 12 passes. `zip_stored_and_deflated` returned 0 instead of 2 entries; ZIP hostile cases and manifest semantic cases incorrectly accepted invalid input.
- Package validation: 7 failures against stubs → passing oracle, integrity, writer, and generated-byte round-trip tests.
- Reference coverage: 3 failures → passes; missing `audio src`, included dependencies, and escaping paths were initially accepted.
- `includes_audio_contributes_video_metadata`: false instead of true → pass. `sequence_pattern_only_applies_to_basename` and `inline_data_is_not_a_file_path`: valid inputs rejected → passes.
- `unicode_generated_globs_match_characters`: `?` failed to cover `é` → pass.

Exact test names, failing assertions, commands, and results are recorded in [TDD.md](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/vpkg/crates/vpkg/TDD.md).

Final VM gate: **passed**. Clippy clean; **27 tests + 1 doctest passed**, two opt-in oracle utilities ignored; layers passed; assets passed (69); wasm passed (51 crates). All three Python fixtures are accepted. A Rust-written package passed Python `zipfile.testzip()` and `sr_core.vpkg verify`.

Integrator: entries use archive-relative paths; `primary_scene` uses a project-relative path. Extraction must still enforce filesystem containment. `Cargo.lock` adds only `filmcraft-vpkg`. No local Rust builds, commits, or pushes were performed.
